blocks.text: More personalities are speaking up against the hosts of the podcast “Machong Chismisan,” who recently published their vlog that made fun and mocked Joshua “Josh” Aquino, the special-needs firstborn son of TV host-actress Kris Aquino. Among them are Kris’ ex-boyfriend, Batangas vice governor Mark Leviste, who said he could not contain his anger after learning of the podcast hosts’ remarks against Josh, whom he said he loves like his own son. Josh, Kris’ son with actor Phillip Salvador, is publicly known to be on the autism spectrum. Kris has yet to comment on the claim of one Machong Chismisan host that […]...
